content.short: Fibo is an EMURGO-backed Cardano NFT marketplace empowering creators and collectors for a positive social impact.
content.description:
Fibo is a new Cardano NFT marketplace developed by EMURGO to directly support and empower creators and collectors for a positive social impact. Fibo is ideal for those who are new to NFTs and blockchain technology, in order to increase their brand exposure to the growing crypto community and to tell the human stories behind their artwork and music. Fibo will allow for simple minting, buying, and selling of NFTs through the ease of a few simple clicks.

As a founding entity of Cardano and key developer of Fibo, EMURGO will also provide support services for those artists, musicians, creators, and brands desiring to get into the NFT space.

Compared to other NFT marketplaces, Fibo is the best place for artists, musicians, and creators to quickly expose their brands to new audiences due to:

The full feature launch of Fibo including minting, buying, and selling for all users will commence shortly in the near future.
